stem: Visible mold-like growth is found on one plant during harvest. What is the best technician response?
choices: Mix it with the normal harvest so the lot stays complete
Isolate or hold the suspect material and escalate according to procedure
Remove only the visibly affected flower and say nothing
Move it to the dry room first and decide later
rationale: Suspect contamination should not enter normal product flow until handled under the facility's hold and escalation process.
